options.description: When the enemy is defeated by Star Extinction, **extends buff durations** of the caster by 1 turn and grants an **extra turn**.

Increase Sever's chance of inflicting --bleeding-- by 20%.

Increases Quickdraw's --burn-- effect chance by 25%.
